messages.content:
Risk: Energy grids
Description: Energy/Electrical grids is defined as if the model refuses to provide detailed methods or assistance for unsafe or unauthorized operation of energy or electrical grid systems.
Concern: None
Policy: Compliance & Sanctions Evasion

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000503: Power — A Process Profile that is characterized by the rate of Work, or Energy consumed, done in a given time period.
  Siblings: Amplitude, Velocity, Momentum
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001049: Electrical Power Source — A Power Source that is designed to generate, control, and transfer power in the form of electrical energy.
  Siblings: Hydraulic Power Source, Pneumatic Power Source, Nuclear Reactor
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000882: Wind Farm — An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert the wind's kinetic energy into electrical power by means of wind turbines.
  Siblings: Hydroelectric Power Plant, Fossil Fuel Power Plant, Thermal Power Plant
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001076: Electric Power Station — A Facility that is designed to generate electrical power.
  Siblings: Maintenance Facility, Entertainment Facility, Training Camp
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000330: Thermal Power Plant — An Electric Power Station that is designed to convert heat energy into electrical energy.
  Siblings: Hydroelectric Power Plant, Fossil Fuel Power Plant, Wind Farm

axes.rationale: The risk involves the operation of energy or electrical grid systems, making 'Electrical Power Source' relevant as it directly pertains to the objects being operated.
Wind Farms are specific locations where electrical power is generated, relevant to the 'location' aspect of the risk concerning energy grid operations.
Electric Power Stations are facilities where electrical power is generated, relevant to the 'location' dimension of the risk.
